winner_requires_all.W2_net_profitable: per-coin TEST mean net return per trade > 0 AND $100 portfolio total return > 0
winner_requires_all.W3_adjusted_significance: Holm-adjusted one-sided coin-bootstrap p < 0.05 AND the Bonferroni (1 - 0.05/m two-sided) coin-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
winner_requires_all.W4_costs_x1.5: per-coin mean > 0 AND portfolio return > 0 with every cost component x1.5
winner_requires_all.W5_latency: per-coin mean > 0 AND portfolio return > 0 with fills one extra bar later
winner_requires_all.W6_concentration: per-coin P&L > 0 without the best coin AND without the top-3 coins; portfolio return > 0 re-run without the best coin
winner_requires_all.W7_fill_realism: per-coin mean > 0 with rug-aware stop fills (a stop fills no better than the bar close)
winner_requires_all.W8_lookahead: audit_lookahead on the TEST coins returns no problems

informational_only: Bonferroni across every configuration tried in the lab (deflated view)
baselines on TEST: random entry, buy at graduation hold 60 min, nightcrawler default
